title: China says it can 'easily win' a confrontation with the Philippines
detail: The Straits Times reported on Oct 16 that China said it could 'easily win' a confrontation with the Philippines, a rhetorical escalation following the blocked Ayungin Shoal medevac and Marcos's warning of a 'new phase of escalation'. Based on the headline only; details of the statement are not yet confirmed.

media.caption: China says it can 'easily win' confrontation with Philippines
